questions.questionText: Look at the number 74. What is the value of the digit 7?
True or False: 5 tens and 8 ones is equal to 85.
questions.hint: Put the tens digit first, then the ones digit.

questions.questionText: Decompose the number 42. It has ___ tens and 2 ones.
questions.hint: Look at the first digit in the number 42.
Always check the tens place first when comparing numbers to 100.

questions.questionText: Round the number 28 to the nearest 10.
questions.hint: Numbers ending in 5, 6, 7, 8, or 9 round UP.

questions.questionText: Order these numbers from smallest to largest: 45, 12, 89, 34. (Type them with commas, like: 1, 2, 3, 4)
questions.hint: Find the smallest tens digit first.

questions.questionText: Regrouping: If I have 3 tens and 15 ones, what is the standard number?
questions.hint: 10 ones makes a new ten! Add 1 ten to the 3 tens you already have, leaving 5 ones.
